name: Manú National Park
description: Manú National Park spans 1.5 million hectares of southeastern Peru, in the Madre de Dios and Cusco regions. Its landscape climbs from steamy lowland rainforest at 150 metres to high Andean grassland at 4,200 metres, with cloud forest in between. Around 850 bird species have been recorded here, and visitors may spot jaguars, giant otters and giant armadillos.
